quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories press release: release 20260831-pdf (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: First-half FY January 2027 results (February 1 - July 31, 2026): net sales JPY 14,705 million (+18.8% year-on-year), operating income JPY 3,838 million (+20.8%), ordinary income JPY 4,526 million (+19.1%, including equity-method investment income from Korean affiliate SK Tri Chem Co., Ltd.) and net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 3,373 million (+21.5%). The company says that while consumer demand such as smartphones still lacks strength, expanding data-center investment from the spread of generative AI and firm investment appetite centred on advanced logic and memory are raising demand for high-purity chemical compounds for semiconductor manufacturing; it also implemented sales price revisions given rising costs and continues to build production at its Minami-Alps site for new etching materials. By end-customer location, first-half sales were China JPY 5,840,821 thousand, Taiwan JPY 4,950,065 thousand, Japan JPY 2,205,819 thousand and Korea JPY 1,276,127 thousand; by application (Si semiconductors), High-k JPY 7,131,886 thousand, Metal JPY 3,197,699 thousand and Etching JPY 1,870,414 thousand.
